pages.notes: Plan 3 called d4 and c5 light squares (both are dark). Rewrote plan 3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Kan Variation, Swiss Cheese Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted a knight from f6 when it is still on g8. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Kan, 5.Bd3 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 2 recaptured with bxc6 and then played ...b5 with that pawn. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Kan, Polugaevsky, 6.Nb3 Ba7
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4-f5 as one route; plan 3 wrote ...b5-b4 from a b-pawn still on b7; the a7-bishop's diagonal was called the long diagonal. Rewrote plans 1 and 3, fixed the overview; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Kan Variation, Knight Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 set up a Maroczy Bind with c4, which the c3-knight blocks; plan 3 named d6 as a move. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Kan, 5.Nc3 Qc7 6.g3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote the knight route as Nd7-c5 with no knight on d7. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Taimanov Variation, Gary Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 consolidated an extra pawn not yet taken and wrote the knight move as a bare square. Rewrote plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Taimanov Variation, Szén Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...b5 into the b5-knight. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian, Taimanov, Szen, 5...d6
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...b5 into the knight. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian, Taimanov, Szen, 6.Bf4
pages.notes: Plan 3 exchanged the f4-bishop for the c6-knight, which a dark-squared bishop cannot do; plan 2 played ...b5 into the knight. Rewrote plans 2-3; British spelling in plan 4.
